category: torrent aggregator (JSON API, Torznab, RSS, Stremio addon)

free_tier.stated: Anonymous reads work and are metered: x-ratelimit-limit: 10, x-ratelimit-remaining: 9, x-ratelimit-tier: anonymous on every search response. Magnets and info hashes are not in the anonymous payload.

retention.stated: not applicable for a user: results are computed per request; the tracker's own stats are published at /api/v1/tracker-stats

egress.terms: no byte allowance on the API; .torrent files are proxied through cache services, and the swarm transfer is a user's

interface_detail: /api/v1/search, /api/v1/torrent/{infoHash}, /api/rss/{popular,recent,search}, /api/v1/torznab (Newznab/Torznab) and /api/stremio/manifest.json. An OpenAPI 3.1 spec sits at /api/openapi.json.
tooling: curl or any HTTP client; Sonarr/Radarr take the Torznab URL with a key; an MCP server is published as an npm package.
chaining: Search for a title, take the hash with a key, ask the debrid provider for a cache hit, and let the Torznab endpoint serve the automation stack.

limits.value: 10 per window for the anonymous tier, returned in-band as x-ratelimit-limit: 10 with a reset stamp 42 to 60 s ahead of the request

limits_note: The llms.txt says limits are per endpoint and IP-based for anonymous traffic, key-based for authenticated traffic, and that a 429 carries Retry-After. The free key raises the quota and is what unlocks magnets.
binding_note: Ten requests per window is the hardest published number; at one search per title a 1 TiB/month pull exhausts it on every batch, so the key is not optional in practice.

identity_cost.detail: A free key is required before magnets, info hashes or .torrent downloads are returned: the response itself carries '_notice: Magnet links, info hashes, and torrent downloads require a free API key. Register at https://torrentclaw.com/register'.

reliability_note: The anonymous payload is metadata only, so a client that ignores the notice will spend its quota collecting rows it cannot act on; the aggregator also depends on the upstreams it names (YTS, EZTV, Knaben, Prowlarr, Bitmagnet, Torrentio, Torrents.csv and others).
confidence_note: Three live searches were executed on 2026-10-23 and the rate headers read on each; the docs were read from llms.txt and llms-full.txt. Registering for a key would settle the free tier's real quota.

evidence.proved: HTTP 200 JSON with total 7 and a _notice that magnets and info hashes need a free API key
the endpoint list, the anonymous/free/pro tiers, and that PRO unlocks Torznab, debrid integration and custom RSS
limits are per endpoint and IP-based for anonymous traffic, 429 carries Retry-After, and the free key is enough for some endpoints while anonymous is rejected on others

notes: The only index that publishes its anonymous quota in the response headers, which makes it the honest answer to 'what is the rate limit': 10 per window, and the object itself needs a free key. The caveat is precisely that split.
